title: 4 GitHub skills that help Claude make videos
intro: Four free skills you add to Claude Code (or a similar coding agent) so it can make better videos. Checked on GitHub on November 18, 2026. One of them is only free for non-commercial use.
reel: From the reel: Four free GitHub skills that help Claude make videos. One of them has a catch.

tools.name: Bang Motion
tools.what: Openers, promos, moving text and explainers that move like video, not slides. It builds a web page (HTML) that you record as a video.

tools.name: Claude Remotion Skill
tools.what: Teaches Claude motion rules for Remotion videos: smooth easing, things that come in one by one, faster exits, and checking frames after every render.

tools.name: Anything2Explainer
tools.what: Turns a topic into a narrated explainer video with subtitles and a chapter bar, made with Remotion. Free only for non-commercial use; commercial use needs the author's permission.

tools.name: Hand-Drawn Explainer
tools.what: Draws the picture line by line while the voice talks, like a whiteboard. Made for Chinese videos first.

sections.heading: Which one to start with
steps: Making a promo or an opener: start with Bang Motion.
Making a lesson or an explainer: try the other three.
Read each skill's licence before you use it for paid work.

note: Free skills, but check the licence before paid work.
